For clinicians

Jobs, pay and assignments

Applying, credentialing and what to expect on contract.

What kinds of jobs do you fill?

Travel contracts, local contracts, per diem shifts and permanent positions, across nursing, allied health, therapy, imaging, pharmacy, behavioral health, schools and healthcare IT.

Do you show pay on every job?

Yes. Every posting shows the hourly rate and an estimated weekly gross, or the salary for permanent roles. Your recruiter walks through the full package before you accept anything.

How do I apply?

Find a job you like, choose Apply and fill in a two-minute form. A recruiter reaches out within one business day. If you are not ready to pick a job, join the talent network instead.

How much experience do I need?

Most contract roles ask for one to two years of recent experience in the specialty. Permanent roles and some school positions are open to newer clinicians.

How does credentialing work?

We verify licenses and certifications at the source, collect health and background requirements once, and track every expiry date for the length of your assignment.

Will my profile be sent anywhere without my permission?

No. We never submit you to a facility without your say-so.

Does it cost anything to work with you?

No. There is never a fee to a clinician.

For facilities

Requesting and managing staff

How requests, shortlists and compliance work.

How does a facility request staff?

Use the request form to tell us the roles, headcount and timing, or call us. A staffing specialist replies within one business day.

How quickly will we see candidates?

It depends on the role and location, but you can usually expect credentialed candidates to review within days.

Which types of cover do you offer?

Travel contracts, local contracts, per diem cover and permanent placement, under one agreement.

What do you verify before a clinician starts?

Licenses and certifications at the source, health records, background checks and references, to your standards and those of your accrediting body.

Do you offer programs beyond single placements?

Yes: contract therapy, credentialing and compliance, a rural and critical access program, managed staffing programs and surge response.

About Mutex

Who we are

The short version.

Who is Mutex Healthcare Staffing?

We are a healthcare staffing agency that places clinicians with facilities across all 50 states. Our name says how we work: one opening, one right clinician, one recruiter accountable for the match.

How do I reach a person?

Call or email us using the details on the contact page. You will hear back within one business day.

Still have a question?

Ask us directly. You will hear back from a real person within one business day.
